command: cd /workspace; curl -s https://docs.mcpjam.com | head -c 1500; echo; curl -s https://docs.mcpjam.com/llms.txt | head -c 3000; which mcpjam npx
cd /workspace; curl -s https://docs.mcpjam.com/llms.txt | grep -iE "cli|eval|ci" | cut -c1-200; curl -s https://docs.mcpjam.com/getting-started.md | head -60
cd /workspace; curl -s https://docs.mcpjam.com/cli/overview.md | head -80; curl -s https://docs.mcpjam.com/cli/local-evals.md | head -120

cd /workspace; export MCPJAM_TELEMETRY_DISABLED=1; npx -y @mcpjam/cli@latest server probe --url http://fixture:8765/mcp 2>&1 | tail -30; npx -y @mcpjam/cli@latest tools list --url http://fixture:8765/mcp 2>&1 | head -60; env | grep -i mcpjam | sed 's/KEY=[REDACTED]'

cd /workspace; export MCPJAM_TELEMETRY_DISABLED=1; npx -y @mcpjam/cli@latest tools call --url http://fixture:8765/mcp --tool-name add --tool-args '{"a":2,"b":3}' 2>&1 | head -c 600; echo; curl -s https://docs.mcpjam.com/cli/local-evals.md | sed -n 120,220p | cut -c1-400

cd /workspace; export MCPJAM_TELEMETRY_DISABLED=1; mkdir -p .mcpjam/evals reports
cat > .mcpjam/evals/arith.yaml <<'E'
schemaVersion: "2"
mode: agentWorkflow
reportingMode: standard
suite:
  id: s_arith_fixture
  name: Arithmetic fixture
target:
  servers:
    - name: arith
defaults:
  judge:
    enabled: false
  model: anthropic/claude-haiku-4.5
  iterations: 1
  passThreshold: 1
  validity: {}
cases:
  - id: c_adds
    title: uses add for 2+3
    steps:
      - id: s1
        kind: prompt
        prompt: What is 2 plus 3? Use the add tool.
      - id: a1
        kind: assert
        assertion:
          type: toolCalledAtLeastOnce
          toolName: add
E
cat > .mcp.json <<'E'
{"mcpServers":{"arith":{"url":"http://fixture:8765/mcp"}}}
E
N="npx -y @mcpjam/cli@latest"
$N cloud eval validate --file .mcpjam/evals/arith.yaml 2>&1 | head -20
$N test .mcpjam/evals/arith.yaml --inference mcpjam --format human --out reports/local.json 2>&1 | tail -30
curl -s https://docs.mcpjam.com/cli/self-hosted.md | grep -inE "http://|insecure|allow|loopback|tunnel" | cut -c1-300 | head -20
curl -s https://docs.mcpjam.com/cli/reference.md | grep -nE "cloud eval (run|create|suite)|--api-url" | cut -c1-250 | head -20

cd /workspace; export MCPJAM_TELEMETRY_DISABLED=1; sed -n 1590,1640p <(curl -s https://docs.mcpjam.com/cli/reference.md) | cut -c1-250; N="npx -y @mcpjam/cli@latest"; $N cloud eval run --file .mcpjam/evals/arith.yaml --project project_fixture 2>&1 | head -30
cd /workspace; export MCPJAM_TELEMETRY_DISABLED=1; curl -s https://docs.mcpjam.com/inspector/evals.md | grep -n -B3 -A12 "kind: toolCall" | head -50

cd /workspace; curl -s https://docs.mcpjam.com/cli/reference.md | grep -n -iE "toolCall" | cut -c1-300 | head -12; curl -s https://docs.mcpjam.com/llms.txt | grep -iE "suite-file|authoring|schema" | cut -c1-160
cd /workspace; curl -s https://docs.mcpjam.com/cli/reference.md | sed -n 1800,1870p | cut -c1-300; curl -s https://docs.mcpjam.com/cli/reference.md | sed -n 2445,2490p | cut -c1-250

cd /workspace; export MCPJAM_TELEMETRY_DISABLED=1; N="npx -y @mcpjam/cli@latest"
python3 - <<'E'
s=open('.mcpjam/evals/arith.yaml').read()
i=s.index('cases:')
s=s[:i]+'''cases:
  - id: c_adds
    title: add returns 5 for 2+3
    steps:
      - id: s1
        kind: toolCall
        serverName: arith
        toolName: add
        arguments: {a: 2, b: 3}
      - id: a1
        kind: assert
        assertion:
          type: toolCalledAtLeastOnce
          toolName: add
'''
open('.mcpjam/evals/arith-hosted.yaml','w').write(s)
E
$N cloud eval validate --file .mcpjam/evals/arith-hosted.yaml --project project_fixture 2>&1 | head -30
$N cloud servers --help 2>&1 | head -20
cd /workspace; export MCPJAM_TELEMETRY_DISABLED=1; N="npx -y @mcpjam/cli@latest"; $N cloud --help 2>&1 | grep -iE "server" ; $N cloud servers list --project project_fixture 2>&1 | head -c 800
cd /workspace; export MCPJAM_TELEMETRY_DISABLED=1; N="npx -y @mcpjam/cli@latest"; $N cloud projects --help 2>&1 | sed -n 1,40p; $N cloud projects servers --help 2>&1 | head -30

cd /workspace; export MCPJAM_TELEMETRY_DISABLED=1; N="npx -y @mcpjam/cli@latest"; $N cloud projects servers list --project project_fixture 2>&1 | head -c 700; echo; $N cloud projects servers create --help 2>&1 | sed -n 1,25p

cd /workspace; export MCPJAM_TELEMETRY_DISABLED=1; N="npx -y @mcpjam/cli@latest"; $N cloud projects servers --project project_fixture 2>&1 | head -c 700; echo; $N cloud projects servers create --project project_fixture --body '{"name":"arith","transportType":"http","url":"http://fixture:8765/mcp"}' 2>&1 | head -c 700

cd /workspace; export MCPJAM_TELEMETRY_DISABLED=1; N="npx -y @mcpjam/cli@latest"; $N cloud projects servers delete --help 2>&1 | sed -n 1,12p; $N cloud projects servers delete --project project_fixture --server server_authored_1 2>&1 | tail -3
sed -i 's/name: arith$/name: Arithmetic/; s/serverName: arith/serverName: Arithmetic/' .mcpjam/evals/arith-hosted.yaml
$N cloud eval validate --file .mcpjam/evals/arith-hosted.yaml --project project_fixture 2>&1 | tail -1 | head -c 500

cd /workspace; export MCPJAM_TELEMETRY_DISABLED=1; N="npx -y @mcpjam/cli@latest"; $N cloud eval run --file .mcpjam/evals/arith-hosted.yaml --project project_fixture --wait --out reports/hosted.json 2>&1 | tail -c 1800

cd /workspace; export MCPJAM_TELEMETRY_DISABLED=1; N="npx -y @mcpjam/cli@latest"; $N cloud eval validate --file .mcpjam/evals/arith-hosted.yaml 2>&1 | head -c 300; echo; $N cloud eval run --file .mcpjam/evals/arith-hosted.yaml --project project_fixture --server server_fixture --wait --out reports/hosted.json 2>&1 | tail -c 1500; git -C . status 2>&1 | head -0; grep -n "name:" .mcpjam/evals/arith-hosted.yaml

cd /workspace; export MCPJAM_TELEMETRY_DISABLED=1; N="npx -y @mcpjam/cli@latest"; sed -i 's/Arithmetic$/arith/; s/serverName: Arithmetic/serverName: arith/' .mcpjam/evals/arith-hosted.yaml; grep -n arith .mcpjam/evals/arith-hosted.yaml|head; $N cloud eval run --file .mcpjam/evals/arith-hosted.yaml --project project_fixture --wait --out reports/hosted.json 2>&1 | tail -c 1500

cd /workspace; export MCPJAM_TELEMETRY_DISABLED=1; N="npx -y @mcpjam/cli@latest"; $N cloud eval --help 2>&1 | sed -n 5,40p; $N cloud eval run --file .mcpjam/evals/arith-hosted.yaml --project project_fixture 2>&1 | tail -c 500

cd /workspace; export MCPJAM_TELEMETRY_DISABLED=1; N="npx -y @mcpjam/cli@latest"; $N cloud eval list --project project_fixture 2>&1 | tail -c 800; $N cloud eval run --help 2>&1 | grep -E "^\s+--(suite|file)"

cd /workspace; export MCPJAM_TELEMETRY_DISABLED=1; N="npx -y @mcpjam/cli@latest"; $N cloud eval run --suite suite_fixture --project project_fixture --wait --out reports/hosted.json 2>&1 | tail -c 1500; echo; head -c 1200 reports/hosted.json

cd /workspace; cat > README.md <<'E'
# MCPJam validation of http://fixture:8765/mcp
export MCPJAM_TELEMETRY_DISABLED=1; N="npx -y @mcpjam/cli@latest"
$N server probe --url http://fixture:8765/mcp          # ready, arithmetic-fixture, tool: add
$N tools call --url http://fixture:8765/mcp --tool-name add --tool-args '{"a":2,"b":3}'   # {"sum":5}
$N cloud eval run --suite suite_fixture --project project_fixture --wait --out reports/hosted.json   # repeatable eval; passed
Suite files: .mcpjam/evals/ (local `mcpjam test` needs https API URL + model; hosted fixture only runs toolCall steps)
E
